name: Morgan Rae Carter
source:
The leader of COSA's Unit Prime, Kollateral is a fighter built around raw brute force. Her scionic ability allows her to convert physical and energy impacts into an immediate surge of strength and mobility, pushing her to superhuman levels. An exceptional power that forces her to live constantly on the edge — both on the battlefield and beyond it.
